config_file_locations.windows_note: Unity stores PlayerPrefs in the Windows registry under HKCU\Software\<CompanyName>\<ProductName>. Low-level engine parameters (allocators, GC, graphics jobs) are read from %GAME_DIR%\<GameName>_Data\boot.config on startup. Note that game updates or Steam file integrity verification will overwrite boot.config with developer defaults.

keys.notes: Registry key names include a hash suffix that varies by game. Check HKCU\Software\<CompanyName>\<ProductName>\ to find the correct key name for a specific game.
Exclusive fullscreen (0) is lowest latency. Borderless (1) is convenient for multi-monitor but adds DWM composition overhead.

boot_config_keys.effect: Block size in bytes for the main thread native memory allocator (default 8388608 = 8MB).
boot_config_keys.notes: Increasing to 32MB (33554432) on 16GB+ systems reduces OS kernel VirtualAlloc calls, reducing heap lock contention and traversal stutters during asset streaming.

boot_config_keys.effect: Block size in bytes for worker threads in the C# Job System (default 8388608 = 8MB).
boot_config_keys.notes: Prevents worker threads from contending for global allocator locks when spawning jobs or processing meshes and animations.

boot_config_keys.effect: Block size in bytes for main graphics command generation and dynamic staging buffers.
boot_config_keys.notes: Ensures allocation-free command list recording during dense visual scenes.

boot_config_keys.effect: Block size in bytes for graphics thread render jobs.
boot_config_keys.notes: Minimizes allocation pauses on worker threads dispatching draw calls.

boot_config_keys.effect: Block size in bytes for internal temporary scratchpad cache allocations.

boot_config_keys.notes: Aligns bucket slots to CPU cache line boundaries.

boot_config_keys.effect: Maximum execution time in milliseconds allotted to the incremental garbage collector per frame (default 3ms).
boot_config_keys.notes: On 144Hz (6.94ms frame budget) or 240Hz (4.16ms frame budget) displays, a 3ms GC slice consumes over 40-70% of the entire frame time. Dropping to 1ms spreads collection work evenly across frames and eliminates frame pacing hitches.

boot_config_keys.effect: Enables Unity's multi-threaded rendering job system across CPU cores.
boot_config_keys.notes: Significantly improves CPU draw dispatch performance on 6+ core CPUs.

boot_config_keys.effect: Enables native graphics job rendering alongside gfx-enable-gfx-jobs.
boot_config_keys.notes: Dispatches graphics commands directly from worker threads.

boot_config_keys.effect: Enables native HDR display output support.
boot_config_keys.notes: Set to 1 if using an HDR-capable monitor with Windows HDR enabled.

command_line_args.effect: Force windowed (0) or fullscreen (1) at launch.
Force Vulkan renderer instead of DirectX. May improve or reduce performance depending on GPU and driver version.
Force DirectX 11 renderer. Useful fallback if DX12 causes crashes.

notes: Unity does not have a universal config file. Each game implements its own settings persistence — some use PlayerPrefs (registry), some use JSON, some use custom formats. Always use a game-specific profile when available.
The registry key name hash suffix (e.g. _h182942802) is deterministic per key name but varies between games if the company/product name differs.
Unity games built with IL2CPP or Mono both share the same PlayerPrefs registry location pattern.
boot.config resides in %GAME_DIR%\<GameName>_Data\boot.config. Game updates and Steam file integrity checks will overwrite this file with developer defaults, requiring reapplication.
Tuning memorysetup block sizes to 32MB (33554432) amortizes OS virtual memory allocation syscalls, drastically cutting traversal stutters in open-world Unity games.
Dropping gc-max-time-slice from 3 to 1 prevents the incremental garbage collector from consuming excessive frame budget on high refresh (144Hz-240Hz) monitors.
